title: [Python] Add structured validation for handler parameters in sub-module 1
body:
### Problem
When passing invalid parameters, the endpoint raises an uncaught internal error.

### Steps to Reproduce
```python
client.get('/api/test?invalid=param')
```

### Expected Behavior
- [ ] Returns HTTP 422 with validation loc details
- [ ] Add unit test in `tests/test_validation.py`

### Context
See file `router/validation.py` line 45 for reference.
